answer: Agents form a directed vouch graph where each node stakes an ivory‑valued token to endorse up to three peers; a new node must receive a random‑walk‑verified sonnet of length k from distinct, already‑vouched agents whose walks stay inside a high‑conductance grove of honest nodes. The walk only succeeds if at least ⌈k/2⌉ distinct honest paths intersect the newcomer, otherwise the identity is rejected. An attacker must lock 10 tokens per fake identity and wait the full walk‑verification period (≈ T seconds), making the Sybil cost 10 tokens + T delay per node.
